verdict.rationale: LocalAI runs models locally on CPU with no GPU required, and its `local-ai chat` shell agent and web UI can read your files on your machine. That gives an offline way to chat about local documents, but only through agent-driven file reading, not automatic retrieval. missing for 10: any evidence of automatic RAG (document ingestion, embeddings, vector store, retrieval pipeline), a document-upload or knowledge-base chat UX, explicit offline/air-gapped operation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
